lyrics.ja: Night Cube　響く拍動
lyrics.en: Night cube—a resounding pulse

lyrics.ja: また　沁み込んで消えてく
lyrics.en: It seeps in and fades away again

lyrics.ja: Eyes on you　揺れる　視界に　綺羅
lyrics.romaji: Eyes on You Yureru Shikai ni Kira
lyrics.en: Eyes on you—in my swaying vision, a sparkle
lyrics.zh: Eyes on you，搖曳的視野中，閃耀

lyrics.ja: 夜が眩しいの
lyrics.en: The night is dazzling

lyrics.ja: 先週ぶりの2人は
lyrics.en: The two of us, meeting after a week

lyrics.ja: 初めましてだなんて　ふざけて
lyrics.en: Joking, "Nice to meet you"

lyrics.ja: 曖昧話(あいまいばなし)気づけば
lyrics.en: Before I knew it, through vague chatter
lyrics.zh: 聊著曖昧的話題，回過神來

lyrics.ja: 何でもない今日を終えてた
lyrics.en: We'd ended an ordinary day
lyrics.zh: 就這麼度過了平凡的今天

lyrics.ja: 揺蕩(たゆた)うのよ　夜の海を泳ぐように
lyrics.romaji: Tayutau no yo Yoru no Umi wo Oyogu You ni
lyrics.en: I drift and sway, as if swimming through a night sea
lyrics.zh: 搖曳蕩漾，宛如在夜海中泅泳

lyrics.ja: 全部なんて　私　いまは　まだ話せない
lyrics.romaji: Zenbu Nante Watashi Ima ha Mada Hanasenai
lyrics.en: I can't tell you everything—not yet
lyrics.zh: 全部什麼的，我現在還說不出口

lyrics.ja: Night Cube　秘めた心を
lyrics.en: Night cube—my hidden heart

lyrics.ja: また　奥底に仕舞って
lyrics.en: I tuck it away deep inside again

lyrics.ja: Eyes on you　繋ぐ　視線に
lyrics.romaji: Eyes on You Tsunagu Shisen ni
lyrics.en: Eyes on you—in our connected gaze
lyrics.zh: Eyes on you，在相連的視線中

lyrics.ja: 綺羅　街明かり　漂う
lyrics.en: Sparkles drift through the city lights

lyrics.ja: 回路図　狂おしいの　ただ触れて確かめてみたいよ
lyrics.romaji: Kairozu Kuruoshii no Tada Furete Tashikamete Mitai yo
lyrics.en: This circuit diagram drives me mad—I just want to touch and confirm it
lyrics.zh: 電路圖令人瘋狂，只想觸碰確認看看

lyrics.ja: Night Cube　暗い夜の底で
lyrics.romaji: Night Cube Kurai Yoru no Soko de
lyrics.en: Night cube—at the bottom of the dark night

lyrics.ja: 少し楽しいね　なんてね
lyrics.en: This is a little fun, isn't it? Just kidding
lyrics.zh: 其實有點開心呢，開玩笑的

lyrics.ja: 数秒おきの言葉が　すれ違った2人の周波数
lyrics.romaji: Suubyou Oki no Kotoba ga Surechigatta Futari no Shuuhasuu
lyrics.en: Words every few seconds—the frequencies of two people passing each other by
lyrics.zh: 每隔數秒的話語，是錯身而過的兩人頻率

lyrics.ja: だんだん冷めた心地で
lyrics.en: With a gradually cooling feeling

lyrics.ja: ひとりぼっちの心地　ゆらめく
lyrics.en: The feeling of being alone flickers
lyrics.zh: 孤單一人的感覺搖曳不定

lyrics.ja: 駆け引きとか
lyrics.en: Tactics and such—

lyrics.ja: Easy Game？　異次元　わかんないよ
lyrics.en: Easy game? It's another dimension—I don't get it

lyrics.ja: 夜は更けて
lyrics.en: The night grows late

lyrics.ja: よそみしないで
lyrics.en: Don't look away

lyrics.ja: まばたきしないで
lyrics.en: Don't blink

lyrics.ja: 隣にいるだけでは　足りないんだね
lyrics.romaji: Tonari ni Iru Dake de ha Tarinai n Da ne
lyrics.en: Just being next to each other isn't enough, is it?
lyrics.zh: 只是待在身旁，還是不夠呢

lyrics.ja: 交わらない　平行線を飛び越えて
lyrics.en: Leaping over parallel lines that never intersect
lyrics.zh: 飛越不曾交會的平行線

lyrics.ja: Night Cube　秘めた言葉を
lyrics.en: Night cube—my hidden words

lyrics.ja: ほら　目の前で告げるの
lyrics.romaji: Hora Me no Mae de Tsugeru no
lyrics.en: Look, I'll tell you right before your eyes
lyrics.zh: 看啊，就在你面前說出口

lyrics.ja: Eyes on you　照らす2人の
lyrics.romaji: Eyes on You Terasu Futari no
lyrics.en: Eyes on you—the two of us illuminated

lyrics.ja: 綺羅　密やかな目くばせ
lyrics.en: Sparkles, a secret glance

lyrics.ja: Night Cube　響く拍動
lyrics.en: Night cube—a resounding pulse

lyrics.ja: いま　軽やかに刻んで
lyrics.en: Now, marking it lightly

lyrics.ja: Eyes on you　揺れる　視界に
lyrics.romaji: Eyes on You Yureru Shikai ni
lyrics.en: Eyes on you—in my swaying vision
lyrics.zh: Eyes on you，在搖曳的視野中

lyrics.ja: 気付かぬフリはやめてさ
lyrics.en: Stop pretending you don't notice

lyrics.ja: 回路図　狂おしいの　ただ触れて抱きしめて痛いよ
lyrics.romaji: Kairozu Kuruoshii no Tada Furete Dakishimete Itai yo
lyrics.en: This circuit diagram drives me mad—just touch me, hold me, it hurts
lyrics.zh: 電路圖令人瘋狂，只想觸碰擁抱，好痛啊

lyrics.ja: Night Cube　暗い夜の底で
lyrics.romaji: Night Cube Kurai Yoru no Soko de
lyrics.en: Night cube—at the bottom of the dark night

lyrics.ja: 少し楽しいね　なんてね
lyrics.en: This is a little fun, isn't it? Just kidding
lyrics.zh: 其實有點開心呢，開玩笑的
